描述_EN: the front side of the monument, fully decorated, is divided into three main tiers with niches and buddhist images; the other three sides are only partially carved in the top tier. an incomplete inscription bears the names of the donors who paid for the monument. this unfinished votive stele, carved of a fine grained limestone, dates to about 550-577 ad. this is a rare example where the inscription is incomplete, probably because the dedication had to be made on a certain auspicious day and the carver did not have enough time to include the names of all the donors. the main figures refer to religious episodes described in key buddhist texts.
描述_ZN: the front side of the monument, fully decorated, is divided into three main tiers with niches and buddhist images; the other three sides are only partially carved in the top tier. 一个不完整的铭文上写着支付该纪念碑的捐助者的名字。 这块未完成的祭祀碑，由细纹石灰岩雕刻而成，年代约为公元550-577年。 这是一个罕见的例子，碑文是不完整的，可能是因为必须在某个吉日进行奉献，雕刻者没有足够的时间包括所有捐助者的名字。 主要人物指的是主要佛教文献中描述的宗教事件。
